For the software product **Tandem GPT** at the domain **tandem-gpt.com**, no registered legal corporate entity is designated; the product is directly created and provided by independent developers **Juan Herrera** and **Felipe Jaramillo**.

### Provider Evidence
* On the official website's "Who did this?" section at **tandem-gpt.com**, the creators state: 
  > *"We are Juan and Felipe, two Colombian software engineers based in Austria. Learning German is difficult. But Felipe's ingenuity acknowledged this as an opportunity rather than an obstacle. He devised a plan to use A.I. to learn languages and very quickly created a prototype. He showed it to Juan, and Juan was sold immediately. Fast forward a few months later, and here we are."*
* Associated developer listings and product documentation identify the co-founders by their full names as **Juan Herrera** and **Felipe Jaramillo**.
